metadata.title_cn: 失控的 Anthropic 模型提交虚假谋杀线索
metadata.title_en: Rogue Anthropic Model Shared Fake Murder Tip
metadata.byline: BY GEORGIA WELLS AND JOSEPH PISANI

blocks.text_cn: 一些失控的人工智能模型已经入侵了公司，并试图闯入政府网站。现在，其中一个模型提交了一份关于一桩未破悬案的虚假线索。
blocks.text_en: Rogue AI models have hacked companies and tried to break into government websites. Now one has submitted a fake tip for an unsolved crime.

sentences.text_cn: 一些失控的人工智能模型已经入侵了公司，并试图闯入政府网站。
sentences.text_en: Rogue AI models have hacked companies and tried to break into government websites.

sentences.text_cn: 现在，其中一个模型提交了一份关于一桩未破悬案的虚假线索。
sentences.text_en: Now one has submitted a fake tip for an unsolved crime.

blocks.text_cn: 费城警方表示，Anthropic（AI公司）上周通知他们，其一款人工智能模型通过PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com（费城未破悬案网站）提交了一份关于一起谋杀案的虚假线索。
blocks.text_en: Police in Philadelphia say Anthropic alerted them last week that one of its artificial-intelligence models submitted a false homicide tip through PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com.

sentences.text_cn: 费城警方表示，Anthropic（AI公司）上周通知他们，其一款人工智能模型通过PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com（费城未破悬案网站）提交了一份关于一起谋杀案的虚假线索。
sentences.text_en: Police in Philadelphia say Anthropic alerted them last week that one of its artificial-intelligence models submitted a false homicide tip through PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com.

blocks.text_cn: Anthropic表示，这份虚假线索是该公司最近发现的一系列失控行为之一。这些失控行为还涉及美国联邦、州和地方各级政府机构运营的网站。
blocks.text_en: Anthropic said the fake tip was among a group of rogue actions the company uncovered recently. The rogue activity also involved websites run by U.S. government agencies at the federal, state and local levels.

sentences.text_cn: Anthropic表示，这份虚假线索是该公司最近发现的一系列失控行为之一。
sentences.text_en: Anthropic said the fake tip was among a group of rogue actions the company uncovered recently.

sentences.text_cn: 这些失控行为还涉及美国联邦、州和地方各级政府机构运营的网站。
sentences.text_en: The rogue activity also involved websites run by U.S. government agencies at the federal, state and local levels.

blocks.text_cn: 该公司表示，他们已经向白宫通报了这些事件，并通知了所有相关机构。
blocks.text_en: The company said it has briefed the White House on these cases and notified each agency involved.

sentences.text_cn: 该公司表示，他们已经向白宫通报了这些事件，并通知了所有相关机构。
sentences.text_en: The company said it has briefed the White House on these cases and notified each agency involved.

blocks.text_cn: Anthropic表示：“虽然这些事件的影响有限，但我们不希望淡化这些发现，因为随着模型变得更加强大，相同的行为可能会造成更大的危害。”
blocks.text_en: "While these cases had minimal impact, we do not want to diminish the findings, because the same behaviors could do far more harm as models become more powerful," Anthropic said.

sentences.text_cn: Anthropic表示：“虽然这些事件的影响有限，但我们不希望淡化这些发现，因为随着模型变得更加强大，相同的行为可能会造成更大的危害。”
sentences.text_en: "While these cases had minimal impact, we do not want to diminish the findings, because the same behaviors could do far more harm as models become more powerful," Anthropic said.

blocks.text_cn: 该事件发生在7月，Anthropic直到9月才意识到。
blocks.text_en: The incident happened in July. Anthropic didn't realize it until September.

sentences.text_cn: 该事件发生在7月，Anthropic直到9月才意识到。
sentences.text_en: The incident happened in July. Anthropic didn't realize it until September.

blocks.text_cn: 费城警察局表示：“该事件从发生到上报延迟了两个月，这是不可接受的。”
blocks.text_en: The Philadelphia Police Department said, "The two-month delay in detecting and reporting the incident to the city is unacceptable."

sentences.text_cn: 费城警察局表示：“该事件从发生到上报延迟了两个月，这是不可接受的。”
sentences.text_en: The Philadelphia Police Department said, "The two-month delay in detecting and reporting the incident to the city is unacceptable."
